questions.question: Which interface preserves order and duplicates?
questions.explanation: A List is a positional sequence and permits repeated values.

questions.question: Which structure maps a unique student number to a mark?
questions.explanation: A Map associates each key with a value.

questions.question: What does HashSet.add return for an element already present?
questions.explanation: No structural change occurs because sets keep unique elements.

questions.question: Which queue operation removes the head and can return null when empty?
questions.explanation: poll retrieves and removes; peek only inspects.
